terms.definition: The JavaScript-to-Go call path, exposed as globalThis.drmd.native and wrapped by frontend/dist/src/bridge.js. Named for the framework that once provided it; the host has been this project's own since 0.6.0.
The local flag indicating that the active markdown buffer differs from its saved text.

The source markdown editor mode, a textarea with a syntax-highlighted overlay drawn by frontend/dist/src/highlighter.js. It was backed by a vendored CodeMirror bundle until 0.6.0, when that bundle was deleted as unused.
The editable WYSIWYG markdown mode backed by the vendored Milkdown Crepe bundle.
A visible enabled UI control that has real behavior today; unsupported future features are removed or deferred instead of rendered decoratively.
